input.text: Before an outgoing wire of $10,000 or more is sent, staff call the customer back at a phone number already on file. No callback is needed when the wire goes to an account the customer has used in the past year.
sources: Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file, unless the wire goes to an account the customer has used in the past year.

input.text: Every wire callback is completed by a wire specialist. The employee who took the wire request never completes the callback.
sources: Callbacks are completed by a wire specialist, never by the employee who took the request.

input.text: Submit outgoing consumer and small business wires by 3:00 PM Central time for processing on the same day.
sources: Submit outgoing consumer and small business wires by 3:00 PM Central for same-day processing.

input.text: The cutoff for outgoing commercial wires is 4:00 PM Central time.
sources: The cutoff for outgoing commercial wires is 4:00 PM Central time.
